# Turath Egypt | ورشة تراث لتصنيع النحاس
> The leading atelier in Egypt, the Middle East, and Africa for bespoke handcrafted brass and pure red copper fabrication, founded in 2012 by Engineer Samy Adel in Bab El-Nasr, El-Gamaliya, Historic Cairo.

## Overview & Identity
- **Brand**: Turath Egypt (تراث مصر)
- **Legal/Workshop Name**: ورشة تراث لتصنيع وتشكيل النحاس
- **Founder & Director**: Engineer Samy Adel (المهندس سامي عادل)
- **Established**: 2012
- **Location**: Kahla Building, Bab El-Nasr, El-Gamaliya, Historic Cairo, Egypt (القاهرة التاريخية)
- **Coordinates**: 30.0511° N, 31.2622° E
- **Website**: https://turath-egypt.vercel.app / https://turath-egypt.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +20 101 677 1010

## Core Industrial & Artisanal Capabilities (تقنيات التصنيع والسبك)
- **Sand Casting & Precision Metal Casting**: Traditional Cairo sand molds and precision investment casting for heavy solid handles, finials, hardware, and sculptural ornaments (سبك رملي ودقيق).
- **Metal Lathe Spinning (تشكيل ودرفلة النحاس على المخرطة)**: Spinning seamless domes, bowls, shades, and circular trays from solid brass and pure copper discs.
- **Hand Repoussé & Chasing (طرق ونقش وتفريغ ريبوسيه)**: 3D high-relief hammering on sheet copper and brass for monumental murals, wall panels, and artistic doors.
- **Hand Piercing & Fretwork (تخريم وتفريغ يدوي بالمنشار)**: Intricate Islamic geometric patterns, floral motifs, and pierced openwork lanterns.
- **High-Precision CNC & Laser Piercing**: Cutting heavy-gauge brass plates for architectural dividers and custom screens.
- **Brazing & Silver Soldering (لحام فضة ونحاس)**: Seamless structural welding and invisible joints.
- **Finishes & Chemical Patination (أكسدة وتعتيق النحاس)**: Antique bronze, verdigris, oil-rubbed bronze, brushed satin, mirror-polished brass, sealed with industrial heat-cured clear lacquer for lifetime anti-tarnish protection.

## Architectural & Interior Collections
- **1. Lighting Fixtures (وحدات إضاءة وثريات نحاسية)**: Monumental mosque & palace chandeliers, pendant lanterns, wall sconces, and floor lamps.
- **2. Brass Mirrors (مرايا نحاس فاخرة)**: Hand-carved, pierced geometric frames, and antique finished vanity mirrors.
- **3. Tables & Consoles (طاولات وكونسول نحاس منحوت)**: Sculptural brass consoles, marble-topped coffee tables, and dining banquettes.
- **4. Door Handles & Pulls (مقابض أبواب نحاس فاخرة)**: Heavy cast front-door pulls, palace entryway handles, and custom cabinet knobs.
- **5. Handrails & Balustrades (درابزين وهاندريل سلالم)**: Curved spiral balustrades, hand-forged spindles, and polished handrails for private villas.
- **6. Luxury Decor & Hollowware (تحف ومباخر وصواني)**: Hand-hammered brass vases, incense burners, and centerpieces.
- **7. Wall Art & Cladding (لوحات وتجليد حوائط نحاس)**: 3D repoussé panels, patinated copper reliefs, and textured metal cladding.
- **8. Partitions & Screens (قواطع وفواصل ديكورية)**: Pierced geometric mashrabiya dividers, bookcases, and decorative folding screens.
- **9. Luxury Tableware & Sinks (مغاسل وأواني نحاسية)**: Handcrafted copper washbasins, dining charger plates, and serving trays.
- **10. Bespoke Masterpieces (روائع نحاسية فنية عمولة)**: One-of-a-kind bespoke commissions designed to client blueprint specifications.

## Geographic Coverage & Export (مناطق الخدمة والشحن)
- **Egypt (مصر)**: Cairo, Giza, New Administrative Capital, Alexandria, North Coast, Red Sea, Upper Egypt.
- **Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC - دول الخليج العربي)**:
  - Saudi Arabia (المملكة العربية السعودية) — Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al-Khobar, NEOM.
  - United Arab Emirates (الإمارات العربية المتحدة) — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah.
  - Kuwait (الكويت) — Kuwait City.
  - Qatar (قطر) — Doha.
  - Bahrain (البحرين) — Manama.
  - Oman (سلطنة عمان) — Muscat.
  *(Note: Strict export adherence across the GCC).*
- **Africa (قارة إفريقيا)**: Comprehensive project export to North Africa (Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Tunisia) and Pan-African luxury hospitality developments.
- **International**: United States, United Kingdom, France, and Europe via reinforced wooden crate shipping.
